headline: Australian Shares Extend Losses as Hot CPI Report Tempers Rate Cut Hopes
summary: The S&P/ASX 200 closed down 0.4% at 8,692.40 points as inflation figures quickened more than expected, dampening expectations for rate cuts from an 18-year high.
why: Higher-than-expected domestic inflation readings reduce the likelihood of central bank monetary easing, depressing interest-rate-sensitive equity valuations.
